name: CIAN Agro Industries & Infrastructure Limited
summary: CIAN Agro Industries & Infrastructure Limited engages in the agro, healthcare, and infrastructure businesses in India and internationally. It operates through Agro, Healthcare, and Infrastructure segments. The company provides edible oil, species, and ready to us; personal care products under OIR brand; homecare products under NEU brand; nutritional supplements; and agro products, such as bio fertilizers and micronutrients. It is also involved in the erection, development, commissioning, and refurbishment of industrial projects and other allied activities; and import and trading of aluminum scrap.
